name: Route 114
lines:
My big brother’s the Fossil Maniac...
He’s a nice guy who loves Fossils.
He loves digging holes, too.
He dug this hole by himself.
You can have this, so you can Dig
holes just like my big brother...

When you’re in a cave, if you have a Pokémon use
Dig, you’ll be back at the entrance in no time!

A peculiarly shaped Fossil is
lovingly displayed in the case.
They’re tools used for excavating Fossils.
